format: Simplified: flop + turn, no river betting. HU, BTN (opener, IP) vs BB (caller, OOP), single-raised pot, BB checks the flop. Pot = 1. Flop: BTN check / bet 33% / bet 75%, BB fold / call / raise 3x, BTN fold / call. Turn (every card solved): BB check / bet 75%, BTN check / bet 75% / fold / call. Turn showdowns use exact river-card equity with a mild realisation adjustment (BB 0.8..1.0, BTN 0.95..1.05 by hand strength, zero-sum). Ranges: full preflop ranges (BTN open, BB flat call) minus board blockers.
solver: CFR+ (regret-matching+, alternating updates, linear averaging) on the flop+turn game, stops below 0.15% pot exploitability
